feedback_driven.quote: By giving agents an explicit reason to defeat our monitors, we can find and fix weaknesses that recorded incidents and routine audits may never reveal.

persists_across_tasks.quote: We track recall at each threshold on a central dashboard and test how proposed changes to the monitoring system affect recall before deploying them.

data.why_zh: 监控系统作为外部环内验证器，按红队和回放反馈修补并部署，持续复用。
